on_screen_text.text:
THE WHITE HOUSE
WASHINGTON

Hosting the World Cup
has Allowed the World to
See How Great America Is.

spoken_summary: Karoline Leavitt states that hosting the World Cup has shown the world that the President and the United States can put on "the greatest show in sports." She describes Americans as "kind" and "hard-working" and the U.S. as "the best country on the planet." She adds that many foreign visitors have been pleasantly surprised by how lovely the country is and encourages everyone to visit and experience America for themselves.
audio_music: Dialogue only, with no music or sound effects.
editing_pacing: The video is a static, single shot of a talking head with simple text overlays appearing and disappearing.
central_claim: Hosting the 2026 World Cup successfully demonstrated America's greatness and positive national character to the rest of the world.
intended_effect: To make viewers feel proud of the United States and its ability to successfully host a major international event.
